description: Drag the edge of a simulated container around a miniature MicroSim and toggle windowResized and slider resizing to see the canvas clip, leave blank space or keep up, and the slider track overshoot or fit.
audience: Teachers, instructional designers, learning-technology developers and learning-analytics practitioners (college undergraduate and professional development)

educational.topic: How container width detection and windowResized keep a MicroSim usable
learningObjectives: The learner will demonstrate how container width detection and the windowResized handler keep a MicroSim usable, by dragging a container edge and switching the handler and slider resizing on and off.
prerequisites: Width Responsiveness, Container Width Detection and windowResized Handler sections of Chapter 12
Reading a p5.js setup() and draw() function
